title: readAt accepts epoch-0 and other past timestamps without lower bound
description: process_update clamps readAt to min(now_unix + 60) but applies no lower bound. A client submitting readAt=1970-01-01T00:00:00Z stores epoch 0, which breaks any unread-message display logic that compares readAt to receivedAt. A far-past readAt should be rejected (e.g. earlier than the message's own receivedAt or a reasonable floor).
